data.title: Bitcoin’s ‘Coiled Spring’ Setup Has Economist James Thorne Bullish On The ‘Next Big Trade’
data.description: Economist James Thorne said his risk capital was in Bitcoin, though he flagged that a socialist-aligned Congress after the 2026 midterms could change his bullish thesis.
